# gdantas — Gabriel Dantas

> Bilingual public portfolio for Gabriel Dantas, a Platform Engineer focused on Developer Experience. Portuguese is canonical at root paths; English mirrors use `/en`.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://gdantas.com.br/): overview and featured work.
- [About](https://gdantas.com.br/about): public bio and engineering focus.
- [Talks](https://gdantas.com.br/talks): talks, podcasts, slides, and their primary materials.
- [Presentations](https://gdantas.com.br/presentations): presentation previews and source links.
- [Projects](https://gdantas.com.br/projects): public repositories and experiments.
- [Writing](https://gdantas.com.br/writing): published technical writing.
- [Timeline](https://gdantas.com.br/timeline): public career timeline.
